speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. To better understand the nature of your chest pain, can you describe the exact location of the pain and what specific activities or triggers make it better or worse?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and gets worse when I move, but resting doesn't seem to help at all. It also radiates down into my left arm and makes me feel short of breath and a bit nauseous. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand you need a final classification, but I must first rule out life-threatening causes to ensure your safety. Given the squeezing nature, radiation to the left arm, shortness of breath, and nausea, I need to check your cardiac enzymes immediately.

REQUEST TEST: Troponin, ECG

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Electrocardiogram shows ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF, consistent with inferior myocardial infarction; Troponin I is elevated at 0.4 ng/mL (normal <0.01 ng/mL).

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Inferior Myocardial Infarction
